adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `GroupsController#members` from returning a flat serialized array to an envelope `{ members: ..., meta: { total, limit, offset } }` (app/controllers/groups_controller.rb), and `Discourse.Group#findMembers` now reads `result.meta.total/limit/offset` and sets `members` accordingly (app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js). There are no corresponding specs added/updated for the public `GroupsController#members` response shape/pagination metadata anywhere in this diff (only `Admin::GroupsController` specs are modified), so a regression in the new `meta` keys would not be caught by tests.
